runner_target: big_runner = forward_mfe >= 0.10; runner model = leakage-safe weekly WFA on 83 online features

frozen_rule.selection: p_runner >= per-OOS-week Q70 (top 30% of the runner model's calibrated probability that week)

dev_internal_oos_evidence.note: selection monotonically lifts EV to a peak around Q70-Q80 then collapses at the extreme top decile; CI-lower still below zero on dev, tail-dependent

known_caveat: extreme-top-decile (>=Q90) predicted runners are toxic (late/obvious already-run pumps); a [Q70,Q95] band is a candidate refinement, deliberately NOT tuned now to avoid overfitting the burned OOS
